newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends unchanged in good liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends unchanged in good liquidity.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed hardly changed against the dollar from its opening as dollar buying by state banks found plenty of sellers in the market, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.63 to the U.S. currency after opening at 56.65. On Monday, it closed at 56.69.
"Although there was non-aggressive buying (of dollars) by state banks, it didn't push rates up as there was plenty of supply in the market," a Standard Chartered Bank dealer said.
Overnight call money closed at 17 percent with the market still liquid. Money opened at 14.25 and rose to 16.5 in early trading, dealers said.
"The banks were slowly picking up dollars without disturbing the market movements," he said.
The Central Bank brought down the dollar by .75 local cents, and fixed buying and selling rates at 56.0835 and 57.2165.
